combination.name: tendl-2017+jeff-decay
combination.note: tendl-2017 with the decay data swapped to JEFF-4.0. Decay heat is a sum of N x lambda x Q, so this moves lambda and Q while leaving N: it separates how much of the deviation belongs to the decay data. JEFF-4.0 reproduces FISPACT-II's decay_2012 values for the nuclides that carry the FNS heat (Ta180, Ho164), so this is the closest same-data comparison with the published FISPACT-II curves.
